prompts.prompt: Wide documentary-style photograph of a guided tour group gathered inside the grand entrance hall of Dramaten at Nybroplan in Stockholm. Tall windows cast natural daylight across marble columns as a guide gestures toward ornate architectural details, visitors listening attentively in winter coats.

Environmental photograph of Confidencen's intimate baroque theater interior in Solna. A small guided tour group stands in the gilded royal salon under warm chandelier light, examining hand-painted walls and red velvet furnishings of Sweden's oldest preserved theater.

Close-up detail photograph of hands working an embroidery needle through linen stretched in a wooden hoop, botanical flora illustrations and thread skeins scattered nearby, soft natural window light highlighting the texture of fabric and stitches.
